description:
We are broke, depressed, overworked, tired, here for the free food and [insert AI tool here] users. We are passioned about dominating the universe.

Looking for like minded or opposing mindsets to keep us on our toes. If you have an AI subscription, please contact us. Or if you are artistic, we can always use a non computer focused person.

We are powered by free food and TJ's need for coffee, unfortunately the role of fetching food and drinks had been taken by our fearless team leader.
